codex synthetic agent through Review, explicit Run and rendered result

single-chat topic selection and actual one-off Markdown output

verified_behavior: Only the selected native peer is journaled; exact IDs and UTF-8 are preserved.
Start validates one-account confirmation and a safe existing log directory before persisting an immutable binding.
One writer polls and applies journal pages while the TGSUM process is running.
Stop persists the disabled plan and closes the writer before returning; retained observations are not deleted.
Resume/restart uses the retained journal and records a separate collector interruption gap.
Prepared or running analysis delays Project application while journal collection continues.
Stopped status after process restart reports unknown remaining counts instead of treating the applied checkpoint as the full journal.
UI preserves neighboring source/collector/package drafts and open collector panels while refreshing source facts.
Diagnostic packages remain local-only; publication preferences are preserved.
not_qualified: A real newly arriving VibeCoders message, real edits and real deletions.
Automatic stock Telegram debug activation, graceful restoration and client lifecycle.
Closed-window background operation and login autostart.
Installation of this worker in the user application, installed restart and rollback including schema-10 manifests.
Complete history, complete delivery or multi-account attribution.
Production source support or AI handoff.
data_handling: This pass used owned synthetic fixtures only. No Telegram process, account API, real chat export, tdata/session database, real diagnostic payload, user installation or system configuration was accessed or changed.
